blocks.text: __**Your PC must be Wired (one way or another)**__

If your Headset connects with Wifi, then your PC must connect with Ethernet to the same Gigabit (or better) router that your Headset connects to. Connecting your PC and your headset with Wifi at the same time causes too many issues and is not supported. Visit https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/767976061476405269 for more information.

PC hotspots are also unsupported.

Otherwise, Quest headsets can connect directly to the PC via USB if you install the Virtual Desktop Beta. Visit https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/592909523295928340 for more information.

Also, Quest headsets are able to use an Ethernet to USB adapter to connect directly to the PC. Visit https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/1390686127937159209 and/or type /dongle here in the channel for more information.
